summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v${V}/${platform}.zip`) and then invokes the dropped Bun binary against the bundled sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array rotation obfuscation (function `WV8StW` cycling an array of ~1000 constants). setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with hex identifiers and indirection wrappers. Neither file is referenced by the package's advertised Docusaurus documentation UI entry point (`dist/index.js`). The package name `@servicetitan/docs-anvil-uikit-contrib` does not match the linked repository `github.com/servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib`, and the alternate-runtime execution path evades Node-based supply-chain scanners by running attacker-shipped code under a separately downloaded interpreter at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
